info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to call out,to cry,to cry out continually,to lament,to grieve, to shed tears

info.value: arTaviSeze GawAdiH . zit . (DAtusaNKyA 773 avalokyatAm) 'AhvAne sakarmakaH, rodane akarmakaH . 'rakzaRe ca' ityeke . ' AhvAne rodane krandeH kandeH krandati kandati . vEklavye tu tayorDAtvoH krandate kandate mitoH' . mittvArTapAWasAmarTyAt tayordIrGavikalpanam . Bavet ciRRamulostasmAt akrAndyakrandi sidDyataH' (Slo. 105-106) iti devaH .
